description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of humanity's presence in spac e ? Lunar Outpost, a trailblazer in space robotics, invites you to join our team ! 
 As a Full Stack AI Engineer, you will design, develop, and deploy AI-enabled applications for Lunar Outpost’s rovers, command-and-control platforms, terrestrial robotic systems, and orbital assets. Working at the intersection of AI, software engineering, robotics, and space operations, you wil build intelligent tools that help operators understand complex systems, plan missions, command autonomous assets, analyze telemetry, and make decisions. You will develop across the full application stack, from AI models and agentic systems to APIs, backend services, web interfaces, cloud infrastructure, and integrations with operational systems. Your work may include AI agents, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, multimodal models, natural-language interfaces, mission planning, anomaly investigation, and intelligent decision-support systems. You will collaborate closely with robotics, autonomy, software, simulation, and Mission Operations teams to transform emerging AI capabilities into reliable operational tools.  

   

 Take the #NextLeap with Lunar Outpost and work on the Pegasus LTV, which will carry NASA astronauts farther than they've ever been before on the lunar surface!     

 


 Working Conditions / Schedule: This position is required to be onsite Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Where applicable, employees may work remotely on Wednesdays from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Additional hours may be required based on business needs. 

 
 

 Key Responsibilities: 

 
 Design, develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack AI applications supporting robotic systems, command and control, and Mission Operations 

 
 
 Develop agentic AI systems capable of reasoning, tool use, information retrieval, workflow execution, and interaction with external software and services 

 
 
 Build AI tools for natural-language command and control, mission planning, telemetry analysis, anomaly investigation, mission summarization, and operator decision support   

 
 
 Develop backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and application interfaces that connect AI systems with operational data and robotic platforms 

 
 
 Build intuitive web-based interfaces that enable operators to interact with AI agents, robotic systems, telemetry, and mission data 

 
 
 Integrate large language models, vision-language models, multimodal models, and other AI capabilities into production applications 

 
 
 Develop tools and interfaces that allow AI agents to safely interact with command-and-control systems, databases, simulation environments, autonomy frameworks, and other operational services 

 
 
 Design and implement retrieval, context management, memory, tool registries, structured outputs, and agent orchestration for complex AI workflows 

 
 
 Evaluate AI systems for accuracy, reliability, latency, robustness, and operational usefulness, including developing automated and scenario-based evaluation frameworks 

 
 
 Participate in design reviews, trade studies, technical risk assessments, test-readiness reviews, and demonstrations 

 
 


 Required Qualifications: 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Software Engineering, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics , or related technical field   

 
 
 1 to 3 years of relevant professional, academic, or research experience developing software, AI applications, autonomous systems, or intelligent robotic applications   

 
 
 Strong software engineering experience using Python and experience with one or more modern web development languages or frameworks such as TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, React, or similar technologies   

 
 
 Experience developing applications using large language models, multimodal models, or other modern AI models through APIs, hosted services, or locally deployed models   

 
 
 Experience developing agentic AI applications involving capabilities such as tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, workflow orchestration, planning, or multi-step reasoning   

 
 
 Experience building backend services, data pipelines, and integrations with external systems   

 
 
 Experience deploying applications using cloud platforms and modern deployment technologies such as containers, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code   

 
 
 Experience designing AI tools and interfaces that allow models or agents to interact with software systems, data sources, or external services   

 
 
 Ability to communicate complex technical concepts, system behavior, limitations, and risks to multidisciplinary teams   

 
 
 Comfortable working in an agile and interdisciplinary environment where requirements and technical approaches may evolve rapidly 

 
 
 U.S. Person 

 
 


 Preferred Qualifications: 
 

 
 Experience developing AI applications for Mission Operations, spacecraft operations, robotics operation s, command-and-control systems, or other operationally complex environments   

 
 
 Direct experience supporting Mission Operations, robotic operations, flight operations, or autonomous vehicle operations   

 
 
 Experience with agent frameworks, agent orchestration, or tool-use architectures   

 
 
 Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, serverless computing, databases, messaging systems, and observability platforms   

 
 
 Experience working with telemetry, time-series data, geospatial data, mission data, or other complex operational datasets   

 
 
 Experience integrating AI applications with robot perception , planning, simulation, autonomy, or command-and-control systems   

 
 
 A record of technical innovation demonstrated through deployed systems, open-source contributions, publications, patents, or significant project achievements  

 
 


 Compensation & Benefits: Compensation level and base salary are competitively structured and thoughtfully determined based on factors such as relevant skills, experience, education, and the scope of the role. 

 
 Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision benefits, with 70% of premiums covered by the employer 

 Paid time off: Three (3) weeks per year of vacation 

 Retirement plan: Up to 4% employer match on 401(k) contributions 

 Paid holidays: 11 company-recognized holidays 

 Parental leave 

 Educational reimbursement opportunities to support company objectives, continued learning, and career development 
 
 

 
 Lunar Outpost Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Lunar Outpost Inc. does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employees, including executives and human resources personnel, are expected to conduct themselves with professionalism and treat others with dignity and respect in accordance with this policy.
